$comment: One scripted interaction per task, identical for every arm, fixed before the full run (approved 2026-10-11, METHODOLOGY.md §11). The gate takes an extra screenshot after it, at desktop and phone width, for the blinded rater. Targets are found by accessible role and name (or, as a fallback, plain semantic HTML), never by stack-specific classes; the first match wins. A missing target is recorded (interaction.found = false), not a gate failure; the rater is told the interaction was not available. Interaction-time console errors are recorded, not gated (the pre-registered render gate covers the initial state).

1.describe: No interaction: the dashboard is a static view.

2.describe: No interaction: the settings form is visible on load.

3.describe: Opens the first FAQ question (the first button whose name ends with a question mark).

4.describe: Opens the emoji picker (the first button whose name contains "emoji").

5.describe: No interaction: the hero is a static view.

6.describe: Opens the login (the first button named "Sign in", "Log in" or "Login"). If the form is already on the page, this submits it empty.

7.describe: Hovers the first product (its first image, or the first article if no element has the img role).

8.describe: Completes the first step (the first checkbox, or the first button whose name contains complete, done or mark).

9.describe: Sorts by the first column (the first column header, or the first button in a table header cell).

10.describe: Opens the profile popover (the first button whose name contains profile, account, user, menu, avatar or open).

11.describe: Copies the first code snippet (the first button whose name contains "copy").

12.describe: Opens the feedback widget (the first button whose name contains "feedback").
